text: Appeal of Order to Comply (October 18, 2021) for 299 Forman Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (October 18, 2021) for 299 Forman Avenue, Folder No. 21 224769 PRS 00 IV (Interior Elements), and in doing so granted an extensions of time to November 30, 2022.
